intro: The Ados Fragment is an inscribed piece of stone recovered from the Whelgar's Excavation site in the Wetlands. Together with three companion shards, it forms the Goaz Stone, an ancient relic bearing enigmatic Titan inscriptions.

sections.t: A Piece of the Goaz Stone
p: Unearthed in the muddy trenches of Whelgar's Excavation, the Ados Fragment is one of four missing pieces required to reconstruct the Goaz Stone. Prior to raptors overrunning the dig site, Prospector Whelgar began translating the primary tablet, only to discover that the inscriptions broke off at crucial moments. The scattered pieces—named Ados, Modr, Golm, and Neru—were lost across the ruins, concealed within ancient containers and dirt mounds amidst prowling beasts.
